module.name: World targets
config.block_updates.desc: Update neighbors and trigger block updates when saving a block. Turn off to place blocks that would otherwise pop off or change.
config.recreate.desc: Replace the block or respawn the entity when saving, so tags you removed really go away (MC-128225). The block or entity starts fresh, which can reset things the game doesn't save in NBT. On a vanilla server this only works for blocks.
config.other_players.desc: Let the open-editor key target other players. The server still needs to allow it.
config.client_pick.desc: In creative on 1.21.4 and newer, middle-click builds the picked item on your side. Heads keep their skin, banners their patterns and named blocks their name. Ctrl+middle-click also copies the block's contents, like vanilla. This fixes picking on servers that run an older version through ViaVersion.
config.pick_debug.desc: Prints the block data and the picked item in chat each time you middle-click a block in creative.
no_backend: Needs a server with the mod, or op on a vanilla server
not_here: That's in another dimension or out of range
command.block: Edits the block at a position
command.entity: Gives you an entity as an item, or summons one
command.no_entity_item: %s has no spawn egg or item form.
command.no_block: You aren't looking at a block.
command.no_entity: You aren't looking at an entity.
command.get_block: Gives you a block as an item, or places one
pick.debug.server: Pick block keeps data is off, so the server builds the item.
